items.title: Anthropic Turns Claude Code's Auto Mode On by Default, Launches Cowork Desktop Agent
items.summary: Anthropic is making Claude Code's auto mode a default feature and has launched Cowork, a new desktop agent for Claude that operates directly on user files without requiring coding.

items.title: Nous Research's NousCoder-14B: An Open-Source Challenger to Claude Code
items.summary: Nous Research has released NousCoder-14B, an open-source coding model that directly competes with commercial offerings like Anthropic's Claude Code, offering a free alternative for developers.

items.title: Embattled Hedge Fund Situational Awareness Invests $400M in AI Chip Startup Source Foundry
items.summary: Hedge fund Situational Awareness, despite its own struggles, has made a significant $400 million investment in Source Foundry, a startup focused on developing AI chips.

items.title: PaDoc: Layout-Grounded Parallel Decoding for Document Parsing
items.summary: A new research paper introduces PaDoc, a method for document parsing that uses layout-grounded parallel decoding to improve efficiency and accuracy.

items.title: CalibForge: Adversarial Solver Calibration for Scaling Learnable Terminal Tasks
items.summary: CalibForge presents a novel approach to adversarial solver calibration, aiming to enhance the scalability and performance of learnable terminal tasks in AI systems.

items.title: KVAE: Family of Tokenizers for Multimodal Generative Models
items.summary: Researchers propose KVAE, a new family of tokenizers designed to improve the performance and flexibility of multimodal generative models.

items.title: EffectLearner: World-Aware Object-Effect Reasoning for Real-World Video Object Removal
items.summary: EffectLearner is a new system that leverages world-aware object-effect reasoning to enable realistic and efficient object removal in real-world videos.

items.title: Historian Jill Lepore Criticizes Silicon Valley's Misinterpretation of Science Fiction and Impact on Democracy
items.summary: Historian Jill Lepore argues that Silicon Valley's flawed understanding of science fiction is leading to technological developments that undermine democratic principles.

items.title: Vaya: An AI Loan Advisor Prioritizing Affordability
items.summary: Vaya is introduced as an AI-powered loan advisor that uniquely focuses on assessing a user's ability to afford living expenses before recommending loans.

items.title: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
items.summary: A new Yiddish language model, MameLoshnLM, has been developed along with an evaluation benchmark, significantly advancing AI capabilities for this minority language.

items.title: Continual Learning in Transition: Adapting AI Models Over Time
items.summary: A new paper explores the challenges and advancements in continual learning, focusing on how AI models can adapt and acquire new knowledge without forgetting old information.

items.title: Invisible Shortcuts: Why Vision Encoders Know Your Camera
items.summary: Research reveals that vision encoders can inadvertently identify the camera model used to capture an image, raising potential privacy and security implications.

items.title: MASS: Multiplayer World Models with Authoritative Shared State
items.summary: MASS introduces a framework for multiplayer world models that maintains an authoritative shared state, crucial for developing complex and consistent AI simulations and games.

items.title: The Optimizer Is the Agent: Reasoning-Driven Search across Prompts, Programs, and ML Workflows
items.summary: This paper proposes a paradigm where the optimizer itself acts as an agent, driving reasoning-based search across various AI artifacts like prompts, programs, and machine learning workflows.

items.title: Modular TTT: Rethinking Test-Time Training as Composable Modules
items.summary: A new research paper re-conceptualizes test-time training by breaking it down into composable modules, potentially simplifying and improving adaptive AI systems.
